narrative: Today's briefing highlights significant advancements in AI, including the development of reliable agentic systems and their application in healthcare for diagnosing rare diseases, alongside a critical discussion on the societal implications of AI chatbots. Key infrastructure developments support these advancements, with new Cloudflare accounts for AI agents. Additionally, space exploration continues with NASA testing advanced rover capabilities.
